mainEntity.name: What is the cost associated with professional GEO FAQ content writing services?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of professional GEO FAQ content writing services varies based on several factors, including the number of FAQs needed, the complexity of your industry, the number of target locations, and the level of research required. Some providers offer per-FAQ pricing, while others may charge a project fee or as part of a broader local SEO package. It's best to obtain a customized quote after an initial consultation to accurately assess your specific needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost varies by the number of FAQs, industry complexity, target locations, and research needed. Pricing can be per-FAQ, project-based, or part of a package; a custom quote is recommended.
